lines.say: They sent me inside a mountain to find a missing witness.
The Registrar sent me to Cheyenne Mountain. A bunker inside solid granite.
A guard stood at the blast door. Helmet, mask, no face.
His badge said, witness nine. My title.
I said, that is me. He said, it was me. Before you.
Every guard here was a witness once. When nobody remembered them, they became guards.
He asked, who remembers you, Daniel?
I called my sister. She said, sorry. Who is this?
